rich_summary: After crippling Kripa’s chariot—killing his horses, driver, and smashing the vehicle—Arjuna forces the veteran warrior to leap down and hurl a mace, which Arjuna deflects with arrows. Kripa’s allies rescue him, and soon the great teacher Drona advances to confront his own disciple. Arjuna respectfully asks his charioteer Uttara to drive toward Drona, praising the preceptor’s wisdom, virtue, and mastery of celestial weapons before declaring he will not strike first. Despite this courtesy, Drona immediately unleashes a storm of arrows, and the two legendary archers engage in a dazzling duel. Their skill astonishes the assembled warriors, who marvel that a student now battles his guru. The sky darkens with arrows as each counters the other’s volleys, symbolizing the tragic conflict of duty, loyalty, and war.

highlight_spans.why: A vivid display of Arjuna’s precision: in rapid succession he disables Kripa’s chariot, horses, and driver.
Kripa, stripped of his chariot and support, leaps down in desperation and hurls a mace—an emotional turning point.
Arjuna respectfully instructs Uttara to drive toward Drona, beginning his reverent description of his revered teacher.
Observers reflect on the harsh duty of warriors as Arjuna fights his own preceptor, highlighting the moral tragedy of the battle.
Arjuna’s arrows blanket the sky, an iconic image demonstrating the overwhelming scale of the duel.

top_scenes.scene_text: Arjuna on his chariot rapidly firing arrows that shatter Kripa’s chariot, slay the horses, and strike the driver as the battlefield erupts around them.
The moment Arjuna respectfully bows from his chariot toward Drona before their duel, white horses facing Drona’s red steeds across the battlefield.
Arjuna and Drona locked in combat as countless arrows darken the sky, forming a vast shadow over the watching armies.
